title: Journalist Kishor Shrestha Arrested Over Violation of Woman’s Privacy
description:
Kathmandu. Police have arrested journalist Kishor Shrestha following a complaint filed by a woman alleging violation of her personal privacy.

According to Kathmandu District Police Office spokesperson Deputy Superintendent of Police Dan Bahadur Thapa, Shrestha was arrested on Wednesday evening based on the complaint.

Police said an investigation is underway into the allegations against Shrestha. He is the editor of Jana Astha Weekly.
